text:
alex: Kicked off a floodwave probe across us-west1 + eu-west1 to validate admission backpressure. Ramp: 2k -> 10k concurrent sessions, targeting ~80k tokens/s per pool. starting now.
probe-bot: FloodWave run 1850012345 started. config: /ops/floodwave/configs/1850012345.yaml. est duration 15m.
mira: Observing queue growth on us-west GPU pool at ~90s, p99 latency jumped to 450ms, worker-3 showing eviction traces.
sam: Logs (tail):
```
$ kubectl -n inference logs worker-3 | tail -n 30
EVICT: cache_out_of_memory: kvcache reclaim failed
WARN: admission_denied: queue_len 128 > threshold 120
OOM killer invoked on process inference-runtime
```
jean: Can we confirm current admission thresholds? IIRC us-west is 0.85 for g4dn pools which may be too permissive for bursty short sessions.
alex: Pushing a canary change to lower admission to 0.75 on us-west. patching now:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/configs -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN' -d '{"pool":"us-west1-gpu","admission_threshold":0.75}'
```
probe-bot: Config update applied to us-west1-gpu (canary: worker-1..4). Next wave scheduled in 60s.
leo: Noted high network packet drops between host0->host2 in us-west rack2 during the first wave, ICMP errors and retransmits spiked. Could be ECMP path flapping.
mira: Dashboard links: latency p95/p99 -> https://dash.internal/d/latency?panel=us-west (shortlink). After 0.75 change p95 decreased a bit but queue length remained high.
sam: Also saw KV cache hit-rate drop from 64% -> 45% under the synthetic pattern because sessions were short-lived and not reusing prefixes. TTL settings might be too aggressive for this workload.
jean: Cost FYI: running large-scale probes at this intensity for 12h estimated ~2.5k on reserved vs ~3.8k on spot. If we plan repeated runs, suggest widening burst window instead of continuous high rps.
alex: Action items proposed: 1) lower admission to 0.70 on us-west and 0.75 on eu-west for next full run; 2) restart worker-3 with updated kernel and memory flags; 3) escalate to network team for ECMP trace; 4) tune KV cache TTL and session affinity heuristics. Agree? :thumbsup:
leo: :thumbsup:
probe-bot: FloodWave run summary (1850012345): total requests 1.2M, dropped 0.9% (admission), avg tokens/sec per GPU 78% of capacity, p99 latency 510ms before change -> 330ms after admission adjustments. Full logs: /ops/logs/1850012345.tar.gz
mira: Filing ops ticket OPS-2191 with traces, raw logs, and dashboard snapshots.
jean: I'll run a targeted smaller ramp (500 concurrent sessions) to validate admit=0.7 tonight at 23:00 UTC and report results.
alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread for follow-ups. If network team posts findings, ping here.
